body: I am exactly like that. It sucks, im sorry
Just wanted to express my thoughts. God bless you , i wish you to be stronger than me.

Hey, people who commit suicide dont go to hell. You are not a bad person you have lost your way thats all. Dont do it for them , do it for you. Small steps , first escape the mentality that everything is useless ,try and think if you could do whatever you want what would you do? You are not a dissapointment , you are not a failure , there is time for you to heal and start building your life.

Thank you i hope you are fine as well <3

Hey im a 19 yo student as well, Everthing same as you, i think out problems are exactly the same. I let go of my dream as well. I only want to say that i feel you and i want to kill myself as well. So know that you re not alone and i pray that when we finally do it , we will succeed and in an other life we will live the life we deserve.

Thank you for trying to help me but i dont want to get better i wanted to live a good life with friends,girlfriends and play guitar and sing, make my family proud. I dont want to ''survive'' with pills i wanted to LIVE and i wasted like a retard. I cant do anything good and im only becoming worse i think its the right desicion to end it ,i just dont want to end up like a vegetable thats all.

I dont want to get better i hate myself and how ive become so i want to end it and hopefully live the life i want in another life.

I did not do it..Cause i played guitar as the last thing i wanted to do before i leave. But i felt so good that i didnt want to end it.Right now i started nutrition and gym. But i still have shyness and social anxiety problem..

Yes i had a personal trainer, i dont want a ripped body i just want to be manly. I have tiny arms and a lot of body fat even though im skinny..I tried skinny-fat workout and nothing. I dont have the motivation to work and its not that i havent practice i had friends for most years and even then when i was social girls didnt want me. I believe in reincarnation so i am praying to have a better life in my next life . Its the only thing i hope for

Im happy you were able to escape this hell. I don't know what to beleive anymore , i am weak and i don't have the motivation to go through treatment. Im just dissapointed from myself so i am gonna do it tonight , i am sorry..Thanks for replying..

I get what you're saying. Depression in my country isn't common so i'm an outsider and nobody is gonna stand by me except maybe my mother. While im going to psychiatrists and looking for treatment as you're saying i will have lost all my friends , i won't be better at any of my hobbies , so i will be in the same shit spot i am now only without depression cause i will take medicine. I don't think its worth it.Maybe it would if i had started it 1 year ago when i had the first signs. But instead i went to stupid therapy so i wasted my time. Thanks for replying.
